contract: the DVD subpicture cases whose FFmpeg result depends on the target, decoded and folded as subtitle-dvd decodes and folds them: cases the reference flags because they reach a C library result that differs between 32-bit ARM and AArch64 for the same arguments (harness/reference_subtitles_host.h)
each case is pinned per target from that target's own reference run, with the reference's flag; a case passes when the candidate, the reference and the target's pin agree
the decoder uses fixed 32-bit bounds for text fields on every target, matching the native 32-bit ARM observations
preparation outside the timed operation: open the input, select the subpicture stream and its configuration, and copy its packets in demux order

one timed operation: create and open the decoder with the stream's configuration, packet time base and options (a decoder that refuses to open folds as no subtitles and the word 2^64 - 1 in both workers), decode every prepared packet with one call each, drain, fold every output subtitle and free it, free the decoder

open_deviations.reading: Text palette overflow saturates at the documented unsigned 32-bit maximum
open_deviations.clause: ISO C section 7.22.1.4 paragraph 8 with a 32-bit unsigned long, as documented for DvdConfig
open_deviations.candidate: The hexadecimal palette field 1122334455 yields white, 0xffffff.
open_deviations.reference: The AArch64 palette field yields the low 24 bits, 0x334455.

open_deviations.reading: A signed dimension outside the documented 32-bit range refuses the canvas
open_deviations.clause: ISO C sections 6.3.1.3 and 7.22.1.4 paragraph 8, and DvdConfig's positive bounded canvas contract
open_deviations.candidate: Refuses both the width 4294968016 and the height -4294966816 when opening the decoder.
open_deviations.reference: AArch64 keeps the low 32 bits and opens a 720 by 480 canvas in each case.

open_deviations.reading: Overflowing VobSub delay fields are saturated before forming the timestamp offset
open_deviations.clause: ISO C section 7.22.1.4 paragraph 8 with a 32-bit long, as documented for the VobSub delay field
open_deviations.candidate: Saturates the signed decimal delay fields at -2147483648 or 2147483647 before calculating cue times.
open_deviations.reference: AArch64 keeps the low 32 bits and places the cues at different times.
